修正參數或接線後再送出；系統不會猜測轉換。: Fix the parameters or wiring, then submit again; the system doesn't guess conversions.
provider 不支援此設定：改用 schema 允許的值，不會假裝套用。: The provider doesn't support this setting: use a value the schema allows; it won't pretend to apply it.
模型與設定不相容：調整實際不支援的設定。: Model and settings are incompatible: adjust the settings that aren't actually supported.
inline 內容超過 256 KiB：大內容請改用檔案（FileRef）。: Inline content exceeds 256 KiB: use a file (FileRef) for large content.
接線型別或埠名稱不符：修正接線，系統不做自動轉換。: Wiring type or port name mismatch: fix the wiring; no automatic conversion is done.
接線有循環：移除循環依賴後再送出。: The wiring has a cycle: remove the circular dependency, then submit again.
latent 來源不符：原來源不會被修改。: latent source mismatch: the original source isn't modified.
元件未就緒：到元件頁手動 start 或等待載入完成；不會自動重試。: Component not ready: start it manually on the Components page or wait for loading to finish; it isn't retried automatically.
元件正在執行呼叫：先取消進行中的呼叫或等待結束。: The component is running a call: cancel the call in progress first or wait for it to finish.
裝置忙碌：等待進行中的呼叫結束；不會自動重試。: Device busy: wait for the call in progress to finish; it isn't retried automatically.
已保存的設定尚未載入：在元件頁明確 restart 後再執行。: Saved settings aren't loaded yet: explicitly restart on the Components page, then run again.
設定已被更新：重新讀取並檢視差異後再保存。: The settings were updated: reload and review the differences before saving.
已有 run 正在執行（同時最多 1 個）：等它結束或取消後再送出新的 run。: A run is already in progress (at most 1 at a time): wait for it to finish or cancel it before submitting a new run.
目前狀態不允許此操作：重新讀取狀態後再決定。: The current state doesn't allow this action: reload the status before deciding.
找不到資源：可能已被移除或 ID 錯誤。: Resource not found: it may have been removed, or the ID is wrong.
找不到檔案：重新取得檔案；不會重跑上游步驟補檔。: File not found: fetch the file again; upstream steps aren't rerun to regenerate it.
找不到紀錄：可在紀錄頁確認或向 Node 抓取歷史。: Recording not found: check the Records page or fetch history from the Node.
Node 無法連線：遠端可能仍在運算，請稍後重新讀取狀態。: Can't reach the Node: it may still be computing; reload the status later.
呼叫逾時：自有程序已取消，實際退出狀態以紀錄為準。: Call timed out: the owned process was canceled; the records show the actual exit status.
協定版本不相容：改用相容版本的 Node／Controller。: Protocol versions are incompatible: use compatible versions of the Node/Controller.
Node 的 runtime 沒有安裝此 provider：這是安裝缺口，不是權: The Node's runtime doesn't have this provider installed: this is an installation gap, not a permission problem.
執行錯誤：設定與 metrics 已保留，請檢查紀錄後手動調整。: Runtime error: settings and metrics are kept; check the records and adjust manually.
顯存不足：設定與 metrics 已保留，請手動調整後建立新的 run。: Out of VRAM: settings and metrics are kept; adjust manually and create a new run.
檔案不完整：重新取得檔案；不會重跑上游步驟補檔。: File incomplete: fetch the file again; upstream steps aren't rerun to regenerate it.
檔案雜湊不符：重新取得檔案；不會重跑上游步驟補檔。: File hash mismatch: fetch the file again; upstream steps aren't rerun to regenerate it.
媒體未完成：這不是完整成片，原來源不受影響。: Media incomplete: this isn't a complete final video; the original source isn't affected.
無法連線 Controller：確認服務後重新讀取狀態。: Can't connect to the Controller: check the service, then reload the status.
同一台 Node 的互斥群組中有元件正在載入、停止或執行呼叫：等它完成後再啟動；: Another component in this Node's exclusive group is loading, stopping or running a call. Start again once it finishes; nothing is retried automatically.
同一台 Node 的互斥群組一次只能載入一個元件：確認後可以先停止閒置的元件再啟: Only one component of a Node's exclusive group can be loaded at a time. After you confirm, the idle members are stopped before this one starts.
超過伺服器的大小上限（JSON 請求或單一上傳檔）：縮小內容，或請管理者調整 m: It exceeds the server's size limit (a JSON request or a single upload). Make it smaller, or have an administrator raise max_json_body_bytes / max_upload_bytes.
這個端點只接受 application/json 的請求本文。: This endpoint accepts only application/json request bodies.
Node 拒絕瀏覽器直接送出的請求: The Node refused a request sent directly from a browser
瀏覽器不能直接操作 Node（防止跨站請求）：請經由主控的介面或 API 操作。: A browser can't operate a Node directly (protection against cross-site requests). Use the Controller's UI or API instead.
Host 不在允許清單: Host not in the allowed list
請求的 Host 不在伺服器的 allowed_hosts：改用設定允許的位址連: The request's Host isn't in the server's allowed_hosts. Connect through an address the configuration allows, or have an administrator adjust allowed_hosts.
請求內容不被接受：修正後再送出；不會自動重試。: The request wasn't accepted. Fix it and send it again; nothing is retried automatically.
與目前狀態衝突：重新讀取、解決衝突後再試。: It conflicts with the current state. Reload, resolve the conflict and try again.
服務暫時無法使用：稍後再試；不會自動重試。: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later; nothing is retried automatically.
遠端結果未知：先確認元件狀態與紀錄，再決定是否重送。: Remote outcome unknown. Check the component's state and records before deciding whether to resend.
內部錯誤：查看元件紀錄或服務日誌。: Internal error. Check the component's records or the service log.
這筆紀錄有多個 stream：指定 stream_id 後再讀取。: This recording has several streams: name the stream_id, then read it again.
研究任務仍標記為執行中：先停止它或標記為已中斷，再進行這個操作。: A study task is still marked as running: stop it or mark it interrupted first, then try again.
另一台運作中的 Node 使用相同的 node_id：修改其中一台的 node_: Another running Node uses the same node_id: change the node_id of one of them and restart it.
這個呼叫或步驟目前沒有預覽：可能尚未產生或 provider 不提供；完成後請看: No preview for this call or step yet: it may not be produced yet, or the provider doesn't offer one; check the final output when it finishes.
這筆紀錄沒有 profiler trace：只有 recorder 模式設為 t: This recording has no profiler trace: only calls with the recorder mode set to trace produce one; the rest of the recording is unaffected.
Node 正在關閉：等它重新啟動後再送出；不會自動重試。: The Node is shutting down: send the request again after it restarts; nothing is retried automatically.
元件缺少必要的設定或檔案：到元件頁補齊後再執行；不會自動重試。: The component is missing a required setting or file: complete it on the Components page, then run it again; nothing is retried automatically.
這台 Node 沒有這個 runtime：檢查元件的 runtime 或 Nod: This Node has no such runtime: check the component's runtime or the runtimes in the Node's configuration.
主記憶體不足：設定與 metrics 已保留，請減少同時載入的元件或手動調整後重: Out of host memory: settings and metrics are kept; load fewer components at once or adjust manually, then run again.
磁碟已滿：清出空間（例如刪除不需要的紀錄或輸出檔）後再執行；不會自動重試。: The disk is full: free up space (for example, delete recordings or output files you no longer need), then run again; nothing is retried automatically.
呼叫已依要求取消（由你或系統發出）：需要時重新送出；不會自動重試。: The call was canceled on request (by you or the system): send it again if you still need it; nothing is retried automatically.
檔案已變更或未通過完整性檢查：重新取得檔案；不會重跑上游步驟補檔。: The file changed or failed an integrity check: fetch the file again; upstream steps aren't rerun to regenerate it.
主記憶體預檢沒有通過，沒有載入或執行任何東西（不是 OOM）：停止同一台主機上的: The system memory pre-check didn't pass, so nothing was loaded or run (this isn't an OOM): stop other components or processes on the same host, switch to offload or pin settings that need less system memory, or move the component to another host, then try again; nothing is retried automatically, and precision isn't lowered.
記憶體預檢沒有通過，沒有載入或執行任何東西（不是 OOM）：停止同一張 GPU: The memory pre-check didn't pass, so nothing was loaded or run (this isn't an OOM): stop other components or processes on the same GPU, switch to an offload mode that uses less memory, or move the component to another GPU, then try again; nothing is retried automatically, and precision isn't lowered.
目的地有大小不同的權重檔: The destination has weight files of a different size
模型目錄裡已有與固定版本大小不同的檔案，下載不會覆蓋它們：確認後勾選「取代大小不: The model directory already holds files whose size differs from the pinned version, and the download doesn't overwrite them: after checking them, tick “Replace files of a different size” and download again, or deal with these files yourself.
權重來源無法下載: Can't download from the weight source
無法從權重來源（Hugging Face 或 HF_ENDPOINT）下載：確認: The weight source (Hugging Face or HF_ENDPOINT) refused the download or couldn't be reached: check that the Node can reach it; for a model that needs authorization, set HF_TOKEN in the Node's environment and restart the Node. Partial files are kept, and downloading again picks up where it stopped; nothing is retried automatically.
時間軸沒有被修改：依訊息裡的原因調整後再試一次。: The timeline was not changed: adjust it for the reason in the message, then try again.
主控關閉了插件的安裝與移除: The Controller has plugin install and removal switched off
主控設定檔的 plugins.install 是 disabled：改成 api: plugins.install is disabled in the Controller's config file: set it to api and restart the Controller to install or remove; built-in plugins and plugins from development directories are not affected.
插件包不合規: The plugin package breaks the rules
沒有安裝任何東西：依列出的問題修正插件包後再安裝一次。: Nothing was installed: fix the plugin package as the listed problems say, then install it again.
主機保護暫緩或取消了呼叫: Host protection held back or canceled the call
Node 的主機保護在晶片或 GPU 太熱、或可用主記憶體太少時讓受保護的呼叫等: The Node's host protection makes protected calls wait while the chip or GPU is too hot or free system memory is too low, and cancels them in an emergency (the message has the reading and the threshold): send it again once the host has cooled down or freed memory; nothing is retried automatically.
